provenance_rows.translation_before: Suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a mighty wind coming, where they were sitting, alleluia; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, speaking the wonderful works of God, alleluia, alleluia.
provenance_rows.translation_after: Suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a mighty wind approaching, where they were sitting, alleluia; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, speaking of the mighty deeds of God, alleluia, alleluia.

provenance_rows.translation_before: When the days of Pentecost were being fulfilled, all the disciples were together in the same place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind coming, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them parted tongues, as of fire, and it sat upon each one of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they began to speak in various tongues, as the Holy Spirit gave them to speak. Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men out of every nation under heaven. And when this sound occurred, the multitude came together and was confounded in mind, because each one heard them speaking in his own tongue. And they were all amazed and wondered, saying: Behold, are not all these who are speaking Galileans? And how have we each heard our own tongue, in which we were born? Parthians and Medes and Elamites, and those who dwell in Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia, Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers from Rome, Jews also and proselytes, Cretans and Arabians: we have heard them speaking in our own tongues the wonderful works of God.

provenance_rows.translation_before: W owym czasie Jezus powiedział do swoich uczniów: Jeśli Mnie ktoś miłuje, zachowa Moje słowo, a Mój Ojciec go umiłuje, i do niego przyjdziemy, i u niego zamieszkamy. Kto Mnie nie miłuje, ten Moich słów nie zachowuje. A słowo, które usłyszeliście, nie jest Moje, lecz Ojca, który Mnie posłał. To wam powiedziałem, pozostając z wami. A Pocieszyciel, Duch Święty, którego Ojciec pośle w Moim imieniu, On nauczy was wszystkiego i przypomni wam to wszystko, co wam powiem. Pokój zostawiam wam, pokój Mój wam daję; nie tak, jak daje świat, Ja wam daję. Niech wasze serce się nie trwoży ani nie lęka. Słyszeliście, że Ja wam powiedziałem: Odchodzę i przychodzę do was. Gdybyście Mnie miłowali, z pewnością radowalibyście się, że idę do Ojca, gdyż Ojciec większy jest ode Mnie. I teraz powiedziałem wam o tym, zanim się to stanie, abyście uwierzyli, gdy się stanie. Już niewiele będę mówił z wami. Nadchodzi bowiem książę tego świata i we Mnie nie ma on niczego. Lecz aby świat poznał, że miłuję Ojca, i tak czynię, jak Mi Ojciec przykazał.

provenance_rows.translation_before: At that time, Jesus said to His disciples: If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and will make Our abode with him. He who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word which you have heard is not Mine, but the Father’s who sent Me. These things I have spoken to you, abiding with you. But the Paraclete, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and bring all things to your mind, whatever I will have said to you. Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid. You have heard that I said to you: I go away, and I come to you. If you loved Me, you would indeed be glad because I go to the Father, for the Father is greater than I. And now I have told you before it comes to pass, that when it has come to pass you may believe. I will no longer speak many things with you. For the prince of this world is coming, and in Me he has nothing. But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father has given Me a commandment, so I do.
provenance_rows.translation_after: At that time, Jesus said to His disciples: If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word, and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and will make Our abode with him. He who does not love Me does not keep My words. And the word which you have heard is not Mine, but belongs to the Father who sent Me. These things I have spoken to you, abiding with you. But the Paraclete, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things and remind you of everything I have said to you. Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid. You have heard that I said to you: I go away, and I come to you. If you loved Me, you would indeed be glad because I go to the Father, for the Father is greater than I. And now I have told you before it comes to pass, that when it has come to pass you may believe. I will not speak much more with you. For the prince of this world is coming, and in Me he has nothing. But I do as the Father commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father.

provenance_rows.translation_before: Przyjdź, Duchu Święty, i ześlij z nieba promień swego światła. Przyjdź, Ojcze ubogich; przyjdź, Dawco darów; przyjdź, Światłości serc. Najlepszy Pocieszycielu, słodki Gościu duszy, słodkie orzeźwienie. W pracy odpocznienie, w skwarze ochłoda, w płaczu pociecha. O Światłości najbłogosławieńsza, napełnij głębię serc swoich wiernych. Bez Twojej mocy nic nie ma w człowieku, nic nie jest bez winy. Obmyj, co skalane, nawodnij, co wyschłe, ulecz, co zranione. Nagnij, co nieugięte, ogrzej, co oziębłe, sprostuj, co zbłąkane. Daj swoim wiernym, którzy Tobie ufają, siedmiorakie święte dary. Daj zasługę cnoty, daj zbawienny kres, daj wieczną radość. Amen. Alleluja.

provenance_rows.translation_before: Come, Holy Spirit, and send forth from heaven a ray of Your light. Come, Father of the poor; come, Giver of gifts; come, Light of hearts. Best of comforters, sweet Guest of the soul, sweet refreshment. In labor, rest; in heat, relief; in weeping, consolation. O most blessed Light, fill the inmost heart of Your faithful. Without Your divine power nothing is in man, nothing is harmless. Wash what is unclean, water what is parched, heal what is wounded. Bend what is rigid, warm what is cold, guide what is astray. Give to Your faithful who trust in You the sacred sevenfold gift. Give the merit of virtue, give a saving end, give everlasting joy. Amen. Alleluia.
provenance_rows.translation_after: Come, Holy Spirit, and send forth from heaven a ray of Your light. Come, Father of the poor; come, Giver of gifts; come, Light of hearts. Best of comforters, sweet Guest of the soul, sweet refreshment. In labor, rest; in heat, relief; in weeping, consolation. O most blessed Light, fill the inmost heart of Your faithful. Without Your divine power there is nothing good in man, nothing free from sin. Wash what is unclean, water what is parched, heal what is wounded. Bend what is rigid, warm what is cold, guide what is astray. Give to Your faithful who trust in You the sacred sevenfold gift. Give the reward of virtue, give a saving end, give everlasting joy. Amen. Alleluia.

notes.pl: Forma „ignis” może być mianownikiem lub dopełniaczem. Mianownik pozwala odczytać porównanie jako „języki podobne do ognia”, dopełniacz — jako „języki jakby z ognia”. Opis gramatyczny pokazuje pierwszą możliwość, ale sama forma wyrazu nie wyklucza drugiej.
notes.en: Ignis has the same form in the nominative and genitive. As a nominative, it compares the tongues to fire. As a genitive, it describes them as if made of fire. The displayed parse follows the first reading, but the form does not rule out the second.

s01.translation: Gdy dopełniały się dni Pięćdziesiątnicy, byli wszyscy uczniowie razem w tym samym miejscu. I nagle powstał z nieba szum jakby nadchodzącego gwałtownego wichru i wypełnił cały dom, gdzie siedzieli. I ukazały się im języki rozdzielone, jakby z ognia, i osiadł na każdym z nich. I wszyscy zostali napełnieni Duchem Świętym, i zaczęli mówić rozmaitymi językami, tak jak Duch Święty dawał im przemawiać. Mieszkali zaś w Jerozolimie Żydzi, ludzie pobożni z każdego narodu, jaki jest pod niebem. Gdy zaś rozległ się ten głos, zeszła się rzesza i zamęt ogarnął jej umysł, bo każdy słyszał, jak mówią w jego własnym języku. Wszyscy zaś byli zdumieni i dziwili się, mówiąc: Czyż oto ci wszyscy, którzy przemawiają, nie są Galilejczykami? I jakże my, każdy z nas, usłyszeliśmy nasz język, w którym urodziliśmy się? Partowie i Medowie, i Elamici, i ci, którzy zamieszkują Mezopotamię, Judeę i Kapadocję, Pont i Azję, Frygię i Pamfilię, Egipt i części Libii, która leży koło Cyreny, i przybysze rzymscy, również Żydzi i prozelici, Kreteńczycy i Arabowie: usłyszeliśmy, jak w naszych językach mówią o wielkich dziełach Bożych.

When the days of Pentecost were being fulfilled, all the disciples were together in the same place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a mighty wind approaching, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting. And there appeared to them parted tongues, as of fire, and it sat upon each one of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they began to speak in various tongues, as the Holy Spirit gave them utterance. Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men out of every nation under heaven. And when this sound occurred, the multitude came together and was confounded in mind, because each one heard them speaking in his own tongue. And they were all amazed and wondered, saying: Behold, are not all these who are speaking Galileans? And how have we each heard our own tongue, in which we were born? Parthians and Medes and Elamites, and those who dwell in Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia, Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and visitors from Rome, Jews also and proselytes, Cretans and Arabs: we have heard them proclaiming in our own tongues the mighty deeds of God.

sequence_explanations.pl: Słowo „dobrego” wynika z kontekstu zależności człowieka od Bożej pomocy. W łacinie nie ma odpowiadającego mu osobnego przymiotnika.
sequence_explanations.en: “Good” is understood from the context of human dependence on divine help. There is no separate adjective for it in the Latin.
